Import the JLCEDA Pro bridge extension"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Build produces `dsh-eda-bridge-extension-<version>.zip` only — a second copy under the stable name o"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"nly made it unclear which build you were looking at. [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- The bridge listens on loopback only (`127.0.0.1`).
- The JLCEDA extension and the bridge both enfo"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"rce the same API allow-list.
- Generic `eda_api_call` is allow-list-only and can be disabled.
- No r"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"aw JavaScript evaluation is exposed."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- The board outline is one `pcb_PrimitivePolyline` on layer 11 (polygon source + line width). It can"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"not be created with `pcb_PrimitiveLine` (a copper-track primitive; the core rejects layer 11) nor wi"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"th `pcb_PrimitiveRegion` (`TPCB_LayersOfRegion` allows copper layers and MULTI(12) only). Verified a"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"gainst real `.eprj2` project files, where an outline is stored as `["POLY", id, 0, "", 11, 10, [...]"},{"id":"p30s5","text":", 1]`.
- `pcb_Document.autoRouting` returns `success=false, duration=0` for every net when no net li"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"st is passed (empty `routingRange` in this EDA build), so `eda_pcb_auto_route` enumerates all net na"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"mes first.
- Auto-routing is asynchronous by default: `eda_pcb_auto_route` returns as soon as EDA st"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"arts routing (EDA shows its own progress bar) and `eda_pcb_job_status` is polled until `running=fals"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"e`. Awaiting a whole-board or many-pin net (e.g. GND) always exceeds any sane timeout while EDA keep"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"s working.
- Schematic APIs (`sch_Net.*`, netlist export) only act on the ACTIVE document; when they"},{"id":"p30s11","text":" return empty/null, use `eda_get_active_document` and `eda_open_document` to bring the schematic pag"},{"id":"p30s12","text":"e to the front.
- `eda_pcb_export_gerber` returns the Gerber zip as a base64 data URL, which can be "},{"id":"p30s13","text":"several MB for a large board.
- The JLCEDA extension socket is registered through `sys_WebSocket`, w"},{"id":"p30s14","text":"hich has neither a close callback nor auto-reconnect; versions before 0.3.3 therefore had to be reco"},{"id":"p30s15","text":"nnected by hand after the DSH bridge child restarted. 0.3.3 adds a 10 s heartbeat that re-registers "},{"id":"p30s16","text":"the socket when `pong` stops arriving.
- Screenshot/canvas image return is not yet wired into MCP im"},{"id":"p30s17","text":"age blocks.
- Changing the bridge WebSocket port requires editing both the bridge env and `jlc-exten"},{"id":"p30s18","text":"sion/api-bridge.js`, then rebuilding/reimporting the extension zip.
